# Target release

**Target**: CASE/UCO 1.6.0

# Background

The SmishViz research pipeline produces ML-derived campaign clusters/subclusters, BERTopic keywords, and psychological-factor / persuasion-technique annotations on SMS phishing messages. These concepts are not in CASE/UCO core and should not be added there as research-corpus vocabulary. A local extension ontology is needed so SmishViz graphs can validate with SHACL while reusing MessageFacet, URLFacet, DomainNameFacet, and uco-core:Relationship for message text, URLs, domains, and impersonation. The five classes CampaignCluster, CampaignSubcluster, Keyword, PsychologicalFactor, and PersuasionTechnique subclass uco-core:UcoObject; six object properties link messages to those analytic/vocabulary nodes.

**Related issues**: https://github.com/casework/CASE/issues/192, https://github.com/ucoProject/UCO/issues/376, https://github.com/varnicm/smishviz-case-uco

# Requirements

## Requirement 1

Define a new `CampaignCluster` UcoObject as a subclass of `uco-core:UcoObject`.


Properties:


- `name` (string): Merged cluster label such as MC(5)

## Requirement 2

Define a new `CampaignSubcluster` UcoObject as a subclass of `uco-core:UcoObject`.


Properties:


- `name` (string): Adjusted subgroup label such as MC(5)-S1

- `partOfCluster` (CampaignCluster): Parent CampaignCluster

## Requirement 3

Define a new `Keyword` UcoObject as a subclass of `uco-core:UcoObject`.


Properties:


- `name` (string): BERTopic top term

## Requirement 4

Define a new `PsychologicalFactor` UcoObject as a subclass of `uco-core:UcoObject`.


Properties:


- `name` (string): Victim-side lever such as authority or fear

## Requirement 5

Define a new `PersuasionTechnique` UcoObject as a subclass of `uco-core:UcoObject`.


Properties:


- `name` (string): Message-side tactic such as pretexting or urgency

## Requirement 6

Add property `belongsToCluster` (CampaignCluster) to `Message`. ML cluster assignment

## Requirement 7

Add property `belongsToSubcluster` (CampaignSubcluster) to `Message`. ML subcluster assignment

## Requirement 8

Add property `partOfCluster` (CampaignCluster) to `CampaignSubcluster`. Subcluster parent link

## Requirement 9

Add property `hasKeyword` (Keyword) to `Message`. Up to three BERTopic terms

## Requirement 10

Add property `hasPsychologicalFactor` (PsychologicalFactor) to `Message`. PF annotation

## Requirement 11

Add property `hasPersuasionTechnique` (PersuasionTechnique) to `Message`. PT annotation

# Risk / Benefit analysis

## Benefits

- Enables modeling of SmishViz campaign cluster and social-engineering annotation extension data in CASE/UCO-compliant graphs
- Improves interoperability between tools that encounter this data type
- The `CampaignCluster` class provides a structured representation where none currently exists
- The `CampaignSubcluster` class provides a structured representation where none currently exists
- The `Keyword` class provides a structured representation where none currently exists
- The `PsychologicalFactor` class provides a structured representation where none currently exists
- The `PersuasionTechnique` class provides a structured representation where none currently exists

# Competencies demonstrated

## Competency 1

An investigator or researcher converts the SmishViz campaign dataset (1,062 SMS phishing messages with merged cluster labels, BERTopic terms, and a sample of PF/PT annotations) into CASE/UCO JSON-LD. Each SMSMessage is characterized with MessageFacet for text and message ID, linked via Relationships to URL and DomainName observables and an impersonated Organization, and annotated with SmishViz CampaignCluster/CampaignSubcluster membership plus optional PsychologicalFactor and PersuasionTechnique vocabulary nodes. The graph must validate with case_validate against CASE 1.4.0 plus the extension OWL and SHACL files.

### Competency Question 1.1

What name values are recorded for objects with a `CampaignCluster`?

#### Result 1.1

A SPARQL query selecting `name` from instances of `CampaignCluster` returns the recorded values.

### Draft SPARQL

```sparql
PREFIX uco-observable: <https://ontology.unifiedcyberontology.org/uco/observable/>
PREFIX uco-core: <https://ontology.unifiedcyberontology.org/uco/core/>
PREFIX proposed: <http://example.org/ontology/proposed/>

SELECT ?obj ?name
WHERE {
    ?obj a uco-observable:ObservableObject ;
         uco-core:hasFacet ?facet .
    ?facet a proposed:CampaignCluster ;
           proposed:name ?name .
}
```

# Pre-submission testing

These concepts are implemented as a **local extension** (not CASE core):
`extensions/smishviz/`. Validation was run against that extension’s exemplar
rather than the auto-generated proposal JSON-LD scaffold (which incorrectly
places `CampaignCluster` as a Facet).

## Extension validation (authoritative)

```
$ case_validate --built-version case-1.4.0 \
    --ontology-graph extensions/smishviz/smishviz.ttl \
    --ontology-graph extensions/smishviz/smishviz-shapes.ttl \
    --inference rdfs --allow-info \
    extensions/smishviz/smishviz-exemplar.ttl
Validation Report
Conforms: True
```

| Suite | Result |
|-------|--------|
| `case_validate` CASE 1.4.0 + RDFS + allow-info | Conforms: True |
| MCP `validate_graph(..., extensions=["smishviz"], strict_concepts=True)` | conforms: true |
| `make test-extension-compat` vs CASE/UCO main / develop / develop-2.0.0 | PASS / PASS / PASS |
| CDO Community Playground (`make -j check` with exemplar injected) | PASS |
